notes.title: Veil of Ashes Gameplay
notes.content:
Our small team at Greifenmaer is proud to share new gameplay footage of our game Veil of Ashes with you! Please note that the game is in active development and the units, UI and gameplay are not final and subject to change.

[previewyoutube=6GYSkVk_W94;full][/previewyoutube]
Veil of Ashes is a real-time-tactics game designed to quickly throw you into the heat of battle, using customized armies and your own play style. Set in a dark, original steampunk world, you fight for the control of Strategic Sectors on atmospheric maps. Either against other players or AI-Bots.

Our emphasis lies on giving you control over detailed units, both in terms of their mechanics and their visual fidelity. Commanding them, your actions will not only lead to victory, but will also shape the battlefield and leave a mark of destruction behind.

Gameplay captured on:
[list]
[*] GPU: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
[*] CPU: AMD Ryzen 3700X
[*] RAM: 32GB
[*] Resolution: 1920x1080p
[*] Quality Settings: Medium
[/list]
